records.context: Given a coefficient (a gene or a guide), the per-object rows out of the imported measurement databases, and the per-microplate sample position guide fractions the regression was fitted on, this module decides **which objects to draw and says exactly how it decided**. It draws nothing: the pixels come from :mod:`spacr.crops`, and the tab that shows them is wired separately.
records.label: spacr.cell_montage#1
records.source: Given a coefficient (a gene or a guide), the per-object rows out of the imported measurement databases, and the per-well guide fractions the regression was fitted on, this module decides **which objects to draw and says exactly how it decided**. It draws nothing: the pixels come from :mod:`spacr.crops`, and the tab that shows them is wired separately.
records.translation: 给定一个系数（基因或向导）、从导入的测量数据库读取的逐对象记录，以及回归拟合所用的逐微孔板孔位向导比例，本模块会**决定绘制哪些对象，并准确说明决定过程**。本模块本身不绘制图像：像素由 :mod:`spacr.crops` 提供，显示这些图像的标签页在其他位置连接。

records.context: what that route needs and what it can offer -- :class:`RouteRequirements`, checked up front so a missing channel list is reported as a missing channel list rather than surfacing later as an extracted image region that will not cut. ``None`` when nothing asked.
records.label: spacr.cell_montage.CropSourceChoice#6
records.source: what that route needs and what it can offer -- :class:`RouteRequirements`, checked up front so a missing channel list is reported as a missing channel list rather than surfacing later as a crop that will not cut. ``None`` when nothing asked.
records.translation: 该路径需要什么以及能够提供什么——由 :class:`RouteRequirements` 表示并预先检查，因此缺少通道列表时会直接报告，而不会到后续裁剪提取图像区域时才失败。未请求任何内容时为 ``None``。

records.source: guides or genes to leave out, by name. Matched at BOTH levels -- a screen swept at gene level names genes and one at guide level names guides, and a user typing a gene id should not have to know which they are looking at.
records.translation: 按名称指定要排除的向导或基因。会在两个层级上匹配：基因层级的界面使用基因名称，向导层级的界面使用向导名称；输入基因 ID 的用户无需先判断当前查看的是哪个层级。

records.translation: results : pandas.DataFrame 置换结果，包含 ``outcome``、``minimum_wells_threshold``、``standardized_marginal_effect``、``adjusted_p_value``、``significant``、``multiple_testing_method`` 和 ``alpha``。还必须包含 ``guide`` 列（当提供 ``label_guides`` 时）。 outcome : str 从 ``results`` 中选择的结局。 minimum_wells : int 从 ``results`` 中选择的向导支持阈值。 save_path : str or pathlib.Path 目标路径。最终后缀可能会更改，以匹配选定的输出格式。 label_guides : mapping of str to str, optional 向导 ID 到注释标签的映射。 title : str, optional 图标题。默认描述结局和支持阈值。 effect_threshold : float, optional 效应量阈值的正半宽。在正负两个方向绘制垂直线；非有限值、非正值和 ``None`` 均不绘制阈值线。 effect_threshold_label : str, optional 效应量阈值线的图例文字。默认显示阈值。 fmt : str, optional 显式图像格式。默认使用 ``save_path`` 中可识别的后缀或已配置的首选格式。 dpi : int, optional 显式输出分辨率。默认使用已配置的首选值。
